name: rtl-floats
note: Float placement under direction:rtl. float:inline-start computes to the physical right, float:inline-end to the left (css-logical-1 §4); the inline text hugs the inline-start (right) edge of each line box while wrapping between the two floats.

harvest.html: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the floats hold both edges of this RTL paragraph text
